task: Fix four Lattice lifecycle UX/API papercuts discovered during B-4ee0 delivery without weakening lifecycle gates or overlapping B-7fc2 JSON-stdout work.
outcome: A user can run validate with storyId JSON and see story evidence refresh, TEST/DONE scope hints no longer point backward to REVIEW→TEST, owner-gated command help exposes takeover recovery flags, and scope warnings clearly say whether they are advisory or blocking.
facts: validate schema exposes story but not storyId, while owner lease resolution already treats either story or storyId as a story target; adding storyId to validate schema and normalizing before handler execution is the narrow fix.

validate handler persists story test-evidence only when args.story is present, so the handler must receive a canonical story value after alias normalization; conflicting story/storyId must fail explicitly.

printToolHelp currently renders only command schema entries; takeover and forceTakeover are common meta options consumed by enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate before Zod validation and should be shown for owner-gated commands.

review-scope-binding deriveNextAction currently renders stale reviewer binding as a REVIEW→TEST instruction regardless of phase; the function already receives phase, so copy can be made phase-aware without altering gate predicates.
scope transition gates already render shadow/local warnings as non-blocking and throw only on fail/corrupt; copy should make advisory vs blocking semantics and recovery paths clearer.
B-7fc2 is a separate active story for keeping Lattice CLI --json stdout machine-parseable while preserving human hints; B-a30e must not perform broad stdout formatting changes.
constraints: Do not weaken REVIEW/TEST/DONE gates, owner lease enforcement, validation evidence freshness, or scope contract phase limits.
Do not directly edit story/fixture JSON; use Lattice CLI for story/checklist/evidence operations.
Parallel Claude agents may edit code/tests/docs in isolated branches/worktrees, but the supervising Codex session owns story metadata, phase changes, evidence, review, and final integration.
Keep changes small and lifecycle-specific; avoid broad CLI output refactors owned by B-7fc2.
Preserve existing --story validate behavior and no-story diagnostic validate behavior.
Use existing smoke suites where possible: validation-protocol, story-owner-lease, command-ownership-contract, semantic-scope-guard, scope-contract, flow-stability, and process-fact contract.
